description: The built-in button toolkit for actions, deck navigation, and stateful toggles. The runtime also injects the settings/back key on each deck.
capabilities: core:action renders an optional icon and label, then runs its configured tap action.
core:change-deck opens a named deck; core:page-nav moves between pages of a paginated deck.
core:toggle displays and changes a boolean or command-reported state. The settings/back key is injected by the runtime; page navigation controls are injected for paginated decks.
